panels.development_identity: same deterministic train-partition development panel used for Step-2 decode selection
panels.final_identity: deterministic hash-ranked validation panel after excluding every molecule in the original Step-2 10k generation panel
panels.shuffled_control: deterministic derangement within the phase panel
panels.nearest_wrong_development: nearest non-self released-hybrid-w3 condition in the 20k train-partition decoder-development bank
panels.nearest_wrong_final: nearest non-self released-hybrid-w3 condition in the complete 50k validation bank

generation.candidate_definition: unique unchanged-policy-accepted molecular identities after canonicalization

candidate_order.beam: greedy first, then final beam hypotheses by registered length-normalized decoder log probability
candidate_order.sample: greedy first, then unique samples by mean untempered decoder log probability

reranking.equivalent_primary_metric_note: the condition norm is constant within each query, so relative-L2 and L2 induce the same within-query ordering

development_selection.information_boundary: development metrics from train-partition molecules only; no final validation generation may exist when the policy is frozen
development_selection.eligible_if: correct-condition k=50 latent-reranked exact identity is not below the same-panel greedy value
selection_order: highest correct-condition k=50 latent-reranked exact identity
development_selection.control_metrics: shuffled and nearest-wrong source-following are audited but do not use original-target information for ranking

go_no_go.rule: GO only if every frozen final-validation gate passes; otherwise NO-GO
go_no_go.search_related_definition: oracle Recall@50 >= 0.85 and deployable exact-identity gain over same-panel greedy >= 0.10
